international.title: US loses measles elimination status amid worst outbreak since 1991
international.summary: Infectious disease is now continually spreading after being eliminated for 26 years, with more than 5,400 US cases The US lost its measles elimination status, global health authorities announced, an official recognition that the infectious disease is endemic in the US after being eliminated for 26 years. The announcement comes as the US endures the worst measles outbreak since 1991, with more than 5,400 cases and eight deaths in 2026. Continue reading...
